notes.title: B1.0.0.5-DEMO Minor Update
notes.notes:
Another small update to address some concerns and fix some errors.

[h1]Gameplay:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated weapon hotbar graphic to show a crosshair on the selected weapon.
[*] Melee monsters learned how to strafe to make easy levels a little more challenging.
[*] Hit particles now scale based on amount of damage.
[*] Reload animation is no longer canceled when dashing.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed errors when closing menus with esc or pause keys.
[*] Fixed problem with crystal spike extra's target from sometimes being left behind.
[/list]
